problems.quote: autobiographical prose work Meri Kavita Mere Geet
problems.problem: Meri Kavita Mere Geet is a poetry collection, not an autobiographical prose work; the autobiographical prose work by Padma Sachdev is Mithi Deewar.
problems.correction: poetry collection Meri Kavita Mere Geet
problems.verifierReason: Meri Kavita Mere Geet is a poetry collection; Mithi Deewar is the autobiographical prose work.

problems.quote: intermittently inserting Shakespearean quatrains to vary the volta
problems.problem: Anachronistic: Shakespearean sonnet form (three quatrains + couplet) did not exist in Sidney's time; he used Petrarchan variations only.
problems.verifierReason: Sidney used Petrarchan sonnets; Shakespearean quatrain form post‑dates him. Correction to Petrarchan turn is accurate.

problems.quote: shift towards "Rare Earth Free" motor designs (e.g., Interior Permanent Magnet motors or Induction motors)
problems.problem: Interior Permanent Magnet (IPM) motors use rare-earth permanent magnets (e.g., NdFeB) and are not rare-earth free. Only induction motors (and reluctance motors) are truly rare-earth free.
problems.correction: shift towards "Rare Earth Free" motor designs (e.g., induction motors or synchronous reluctance motors)
problems.verifierReason: IPM motors typically use NdFeB rare-earth magnets; induction and synchronous reluctance motors are correctly rare-earth free.

problems.quote: 11 vowels + 33 consonants = 44 sounds (plus 4 yogavahik in extended counts: अं, अः, plus conjunct forms)
problems.problem: Hindi varnamala has 11 vowels (अ–औ) + 33 consonants = 44; yogavahas are only anusvāra (अं) and visarga (अः) — two, not four; conjunct forms are not yogavahas.
problems.correction: 11 vowels + 33 consonants = 44 sounds (plus 2 yogavāha: अं, अः)
problems.verifierReason: Original wrongly counts 4 yogavāhas including conjuncts; correction correctly identifies only anusvāra and visarga as yogavāhas.

problems.problem: द्वि is not a conjunct consonant; it is the syllable द्+व+इ. The conjunct is द्व (द+व).
problems.verifierReason: द्वि is a syllable (consonant+vowel), not a conjunct consonant; correction gives the proper conjunct द्व.

problems.quote: उपसर्ग 20 : अति, अधि, अनु, अप, अभि, अव, आ, उत्, उप, प्रति, परा, परि, प्र, वि, सम्, सु, नि, दुर्, अपि, निस्
problems.problem: Standard upasarga list uses उद् (not उत्), निर् (not निस्); अपि is a particle, not an upasarga.
problems.correction: उपसर्ग 20 : अति, अधि, अनु, अप, अभि, अव, आ, उद्, उप, प्रति, परा, परि, प्र, वि, सम्, सु, नि, दुर्, निर्, (अन्य मान्य उपसर्ग)
problems.verifierReason: Original uses non-standard forms उत्, निस् and includes particle अपि; correction uses standard उद्, निर् and removes अपि.

problems.problem: The avagraha mark (ઽ) indicates elision of an inherent ‘a’ in Sanskrit sandhi; it cannot be added to ‘સ્વર્ગ’ which has no elided vowel. The example is linguistically invalid.
problems.correction: changing the reading of “મહા ઇશ્વર” to “મહાઽઇશ્વર”
problems.verifierReason: Avagraha marks elided 'a'; 'svarga' lacks it; correction uses valid mahā+īśvara sandhi.
